title: GPS Denied Localization and Magnetometer-Free Yaw Estimation for Multi-rotor UAVs
authors: Balaji N.; Kothari M.; Abhishek A.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
